plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Theatre, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1421R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/visual-performing-and-liberal-arts-department/theatre/theatre-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). HONEST CONTRADICTION DOCUMENTED: the catalog's Semester 3 (Fall Sophomore) rows sum to 18-19 credits (SOCS GE 3 + THEA 151 2 + THEA 201 3 + SCIG GE2 3-4 + COMM GE 3 + THEA 113 3 + THEA 280 1) against a printed semester total of 17, and the catalog's 60-credit minimum total is unreachable under the printed rows combined with the program note 'THEA 151 must be taken for 6 credits during the program term'. Modeled at the faithful-rows reading: every printed row value transcribed verbatim (THEA 151 = 2 in semesters 1-3 as printed, SCIG GE2 at its 3-credit minimum), giving semester totals 17/13/18/13 = 61, which sits inside the catalog's published 'Total Credit Hours: 60-62'. The printed semester-3 total of 17 appears to be a catalog arithmetic error. Variable credit: 'THEA 151 Play Production 0-2 credits' in semesters 1-2 modeled at 2 credits each (the value required for the printed semester totals and the 6-credit program requirement); modeled as choice slots since the credit load is student choice. The catalog adds 'THEA 151: May take as 0 to 2 credits as desired after accumulating 6 credits.' Choice slots: MATH GE / SCIG GE / SCIG GE2 / SOCS GE / SOCS GE2 / COMM GE / HUMA GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnotes: Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanities courses must be from 2 disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
